_: AUTHORED — the art release this tree pins (docs/ART-REPO-PLAN.md, docs/EXTERNAL-ASSETS-PLAN.md §2). Schema 2: one tag, three zips (high, light, common), each with its sha256. tools/fetch-art.mjs downloads each zip, checks its sha256, then every file against art-manifest.json, and unpacks it into .art-cache/<tag>/<pack>/. The top-level zip and sha256 equal packs.high, for readers that predate schema 2. Bumped by hand in the PR that adopts a new release. Part of the build identity (tools/buildversion.mjs BUILD_IDENTITY_FILES).
